title: Fixed section pushforward comparison in scalar functor notation
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative condensed ring and $h:U\to V$ a scheme morphism. Use the unbounded internal direct image $F_{h,R}$ of [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons], the localized section equivalences $\bar E_{R,U},\bar E_{R,V}$ of [def-pd-section-derived-tensor-data], and the specified section direct image $F^s_{h,R}$ and canonical derived pushforward realization of [def-pd-section-derived-realization]. Define $\operatorname{scalarSectionPushComparison}(R,h):F_{h,R}\bar E_{R,V}\simeq\bar E_{R,U}F^s_{h,R}$ (apply the left functor first) to be exactly that existing derived pushforward comparison, after unfolding the internal name $F$. There is no additional choice or compatibility theorem. Retain independent small pro-etale site object and morphism universes and arbitrary unbounded complexes.

lean.statement:
def scalarSectionPushComparison
    (R : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R]
    [∀ T : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleRingedComparison.modules R T)]
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (h : U ⟶ V) :
    F R h ⋙ ModuleRingedComparison.derivedFunctor R V ≅
      ModuleRingedComparison.derivedFunctor R U ⋙
        ModuleRingedComparison.derivedPushforward R h
